dslRule:
<!id: use-stringbuilder-for-local-vars>
<!description: Replaces new StringBuffer() with new StringBuilder() when assigned to a local variable.>
<!severity: INFO>
<!tags: performance, java-5>

new java.lang.StringBuffer($args$) :: isAssignedToLocalVariable()
=> new java.lang.StringBuilder($args$)
;;
summary: Replace new StringBuffer() with new StringBuilder() for local variables to improve performance.
